verses.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: יֹֽאמַר־נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: So let Israel now say, For His mercy endureth for ever,

verses.he: יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָ֥א בֵֽית־אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: So let the house of Aaron now say, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: So let them now that fear the LORD say, For His mercy endureth for ever.

verses.he: מִֽן־הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Out of my straits I called upon the LORD; He answered me with great enlargement.

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.en: The LORD is for me; I will not fear; What can man do unto me?

verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃
verses.en: The LORD is for me as my helper; And I shall gaze upon them that hate me.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃
verses.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in man.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב לַחֲס֥וֹת בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃
verses.en: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in princes.

verses.he: כָּל־גּוֹיִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.en: All nations compass me about; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

verses.he: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.en: They compass me about, yea, they compass me about; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

verses.he: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבוֹרִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קוֹצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃
verses.en: They compass me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

verses.he: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃
verses.en: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But the LORD helped me.

verses.he: עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: The LORD is my strength and song; And He is become my salvation.

verses.he: ק֤וֹל׀ רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

verses.he: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רוֹמֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.en: The right hand of the LORD is exalted; The right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

verses.he: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי־אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the LORD.

verses.he: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃
verses.en: The LORD hath chastened me sore; But He hath not given me over unto death.

verses.he: פִּתְחוּ־לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא־בָ֝ם אוֹדֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃
verses.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto the LORD.

verses.he: זֶֽה־הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: This is the gate of the LORD; The righteous shall enter into it.

verses.he: א֭וֹדְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: I will give thanks unto Thee, for Thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.

verses.he: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבּוֹנִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃
verses.en: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the chief corner-stone.

verses.he: מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.en: This is the LORD’S doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.

verses.he: זֶה־הַ֭יּוֹם עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֽוֹ׃
verses.en: This is the day which the LORD hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.he: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הוֹשִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃
verses.en: We beseech Thee, O LORD, save now! We beseech Thee, O LORD, make us now to prosper!

verses.he: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD; We bless you out of the house of the LORD.

verses.he: אֵ֤ל׀ יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֪אֶר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־קַ֝רְנ֗וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.en: The LORD is God, and hath given us light; Order the festival procession with boughs, even unto the horns of the altar.

verses.he: אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאוֹדֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרוֹמְמֶֽךָּ׃
verses.en: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto Thee; Thou art my God, I will exalt Thee.

verses.he: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.
